name: curvy-earwig
description: A 301px by 56px search field with layered conic borders, a filter affordance, and focus glow.
purpose: Gives headers a high-contrast search target with a subtle animated edge and native text input.
bestFor: header or toolbar search that should stay quiet until used
playful catalogue filters that still need a native text field
demo surfaces that show a collapsed and open search state
avoidFor: always-visible search on dense data tables
forms that need a labeled field sitting in a grid
